query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS molecule_chemical_families (
  moleculeId INT NOT NULL,
  chemicalFamilyId INT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (moleculeId, chemicalFamilyId),
  FOREIGN KEY (moleculeId) REFERENCES molecules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (chemicalFamilyId) REFERENCES chemical_families(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
